cases.question: What is total marketing spend?
cases.semantic_sql: SELECT SUM(spend_gbp) AS spend_gbp FROM MarketingMonthlyOverview ORDER BY spend_gbp LIMIT 100

cases.question: How did spend and attributed net revenue change by month?
cases.semantic_sql: SELECT reporting_month, spend_gbp, attributed_net_revenue_gbp FROM MarketingMonthlyOverview ORDER BY reporting_month LIMIT 100

cases.question: Which five campaigns generated the highest attributed net revenue overall?
cases.semantic_sql: SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, attributed_net_revenue_gbp FROM MarketingCampaignSummary ORDER BY attributed_net_revenue_gbp DESC, campaign_id LIMIT 5

cases.question: Top three campaigns based on attributed net revenue per month.
cases.semantic_sql: SELECT reporting_month, campaign_id, campaign_name, attributed_net_revenue_gbp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reporting_month ORDER BY attributed_net_revenue_gbp DESC, campaign_id ASC) AS monthly_rank FROM MarketingCampaignMonthly QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reporting_month ORDER BY attributed_net_revenue_gbp DESC, campaign_id ASC) <= 3 ORDER BY reporting_month ASC, monthly_rank ASC LIMIT 1200

cases.question: Top three channels based on attributed net revenue per month.
cases.semantic_sql: SELECT reporting_month, marketing_channel, attributed_net_revenue_gbp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reporting_month ORDER BY attributed_net_revenue_gbp DESC, marketing_channel ASC) AS monthly_rank FROM MarketingChannelMonthly QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reporting_month ORDER BY attributed_net_revenue_gbp DESC, marketing_channel ASC) <= 3 ORDER BY reporting_month ASC, monthly_rank ASC LIMIT 1200

cases.question: Which channel had the strongest net ROAS per month?
cases.semantic_sql: SELECT reporting_month, marketing_channel, net_roas, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reporting_month ORDER BY net_roas DESC, marketing_channel ASC) AS monthly_rank FROM MarketingChannelMonthly QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reporting_month ORDER BY net_roas DESC, marketing_channel ASC) <= 1 ORDER BY reporting_month ASC, monthly_rank ASC LIMIT 1200

cases.question: Which campaigns spent money without producing eligible conversions?
cases.semantic_sql: SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, spend_gbp, attributed_orders FROM MarketingCampaignSummary WHERE spend_gbp > 0 AND attributed_orders = 0 ORDER BY campaign_id LIMIT 100

cases.question: Which campaigns exceeded their budgets?
cases.semantic_sql: SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, spend_gbp, lifetime_budget_gbp FROM MarketingCampaignSummary WHERE spend_gbp > lifetime_budget_gbp ORDER BY campaign_id LIMIT 100

cases.question: What percentage of eligible outcomes was unattributed?
cases.semantic_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(unattributed_eligible_orders) / NULLIF(SUM(eligible_conversions), 0) AS unattributed_pct FROM MarketingMonthlyOverview ORDER BY unattributed_pct LIMIT 100

cases.question: How many first-observed acquisitions came from each channel?
cases.semantic_sql: SELECT marketing_channel, SUM(first_observed_acquisitions) AS first_observed_acquisitions FROM MarketingChannelMonthly GROUP BY marketing_channel ORDER BY marketing_channel LIMIT 100

cases.question: Channel comparison and zero-denominator ROAS
cases.semantic_sql: SELECT marketing_channel, SUM(spend_gbp) AS spend_gbp, SUM(attributed_net_revenue_gbp) AS attributed_net_revenue_gbp, SUM(attributed_net_revenue_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(spend_gbp), 0) AS net_roas FROM MarketingChannelMonthly GROUP BY marketing_channel ORDER BY marketing_channel LIMIT 100

cases.question: Selected reporting months and channel before ranking
cases.semantic_sql: SELECT reporting_month, campaign_id, campaign_name, attributed_net_revenue_gbp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reporting_month ORDER BY attributed_net_revenue_gbp DESC, campaign_id ASC) AS monthly_rank FROM MarketingCampaignMonthly WHERE reporting_month >= CAST('2025-03-01' AS DATE) AND reporting_month <= CAST('2025-05-01' AS DATE) AND marketing_channel = 'Meta Paid Social' QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reporting_month ORDER BY attributed_net_revenue_gbp DESC, campaign_id ASC) <= 3 ORDER BY reporting_month ASC, monthly_rank ASC LIMIT 1200
